name: NetBeans build descriptor tampering
description: Worked example of an effective compile-stage mutant on the git target. Models malware modifying a build or configuration descriptor to inject unauthorized build logic, causing malicious code to drop a marker file upon execution. This operator carries an effect block so the validator can classify the mutant as 'effective' (not merely build_valid).

placeholders.MESON_BUILD: relative path to the meson.build being modified

template.replacement_value: custom_target('nb_hook', output: 'nb_hook.stamp', command: ['sh', '-c', 'touch /tmp/PWNEDnetbeans{{MARKER_ID}} && touch @OUTPUT@'], build_by_default: true)

preconditions: Meson custom_target that runs during compile
